plan.notes: Source: Alexandria Technical & Community College 2025-2026 Catalog (official PDF, updated August 25, 2025), 'Sociology Transfer Pathway' Associate of Arts degree course sequence, PROGRAM CREDITS: 60. Hand-transcribed 2026-10-01. The catalog states: 'This course sequence is an example. Visit with advisor or refer to Degree Audit Report for elective options.' Note: AA Degrees must have general education courses from all 10 goal areas of the MN Transfer Curriculum. Choice slots with no catalog option list have no printed options; see advisor or Degree Audit Report. The 'Individualized Degree Plan (or CRLT1439)' row is a dual-option slot. The catalog does not list prerequisites in the sequence.
